verdict.rationale: Otter's own enterprise docs say it auto-generates follow-up emails and next steps from client calls, using Work Mode and AI Chat. The evidence does not show a review-and-send flow that lets the sales lead send the draft in a couple of clicks, and the claims are marketing-level only. missing for 10: documented review/edit-and-send workflow (e.g., email client or Gmail/Outlook send integration), plan availability details beyond enterprise pages, independent or hands-on corroboration of draft quality.

support.subject: As a sales lead, the tool drafts my follow-up email from the meeting so I can review and send it in a couple of clicks

citations.quote: Instantly auto-generate follow-up emails and next steps for client calls,  internal reviews, and more.
Use Work Mode to draft follow-up emails and next steps for client calls, internal reviews, and more.
help you create follow-ups, reports, and content
